name: MCB 4026W
title: Advanced Biochemistry Laboratory
description: Theory and application of modern techniques for separation and characterization of biological macromolecules, including several types of liquid chromatography, liquid scintillation spectro-photometry, and SDS polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.
